EX series · EM

Emerald

Released May 1, 2005 · 107 cards

Emerald is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on May 1, 2005. Its main set has 106 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (107 in total). It includes 86 Pokémon, 11 Trainer and 10 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

18 illustrators worked on Emerald. Most cards: Kouki Saitou (12), Atsuko Nishida (11), Kagemaru Himeno (11), Mitsuhiro Arita (10), Masakazu Fukuda (9), Midori Harada (8), Hajime Kusajima (7), Hikaru Koike (5).
